motivation: A live J2 worker sample was dominated by row-wise CSV dictionary serialization and integer/string formatting rather than phase-field kernels or gzip deflation.
selected_implementation: Fixed-schema column buffers written as one atomic Zstandard Parquet part per authoritative checkpoint.
restart_contract: The checkpoint stores the committed part count. Resume deletes all later parts and temporary parts before continuing, while CSV/gzip byte-offset restart remains supported.
